fusions.name: Mouldy Tooth
fusions.desc: Spits a tuft of spores that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spore Bed Raid
fusions.desc: Scurries through the spore bed, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Puffball Cache
fusions.desc: Hides a puffball at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 40 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles take 18 damage in a burst of spores that leaves them [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gets In Everywhere
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them.
